_comment: Fixtures for the 'no-website home services prospects' niche
(HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, landscaping, garage door,
pest control, pressure washing, handyman). Every row is INVENTED.
NOTE on 'drop' rows: the self-test runs must-drop fixtures in 'generous'
mode, which auto-fills a website onto every row that doesn't specify
one. Since this niche hard-denies any listing WITH a website
(filter.require_no_website), that means every drop row below will in
practice be caught by the website rule first, on top of whatever other
reason is named in `why`. That's still a correct assertion (all of
these must never export) — the independent proof that deny_terms,
primary_category_deny, max_reviews and toll-free detection ALSO catch
these on their own (without the website confound) was run separately
against the Classifier with website=None for each case.
'keep' and 'low' rows run in exact mode (no auto-fill), so they
deliberately omit `website` — a keep row WITH a website would now be a
must-drop case, which is the point of this niche.
